zh:
ETF 連 7 個交易日流出後，11/16 只回來 940 萬美元。
64K 停住是賣方停手，不是新錢進場；新錢回來之前，反彈很難走遠。

・市場階段：牛市（第 40 天）
・ETF 7 個交易日（至 11/16）：−12.86 億美元

短線偏空：64K 守了三天是賣方停手，穩定幣和 ETF 的錢還在往外走，持多單的帳戶卻還有 72%，沒有新錢接，這些多單就是下一波賣壓。
長線偏多：估值已在歷來底部區，晨昏指數在深夜、未實現獲利第 4 天在週期地板下，缺的是買家，價格已經夠便宜。
要等穩定幣或 ETF 轉回淨流入，止跌才算數；收盤跌破 62K，下面到 58K 短期籌碼很薄。

Daybreak No.043｜11/17 完整解讀 👉 https://daybreak.aronlab.dev/?utm_source=x

en:
After 7 straight outflow days, BTC ETFs took in just $9.4M on Nov 16.
64K is holding because sellers stopped, not because new money came in; until it does, bounces won't go far.

・Market stage: bull (day 40)
・ETF 7 trading days to Nov 16: −$1.29B

Short-term bearish: 64K has held three days because sellers stepped back; stablecoin and ETF money is still leaving, 72% of accounts are long, and without new money those longs are the next selling wave.
Long-term bullish: the Dawn Index is in Deep Night and unrealized profit has sat below the cycle floor for 4 days; price is cheap, buyers are missing.
The pause counts once stablecoins or ETFs turn to net inflows; below 62K, few coins sit down to 58K.
